title: tanacetum niveum
intro: Tanacetum niveum, commonly known as White Tansy or Chrysanthemum White, is a flowering plant in the daisy family. This perennial herb is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Tanacetum niveum include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to reduce pain, fever, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
